description: This file defines inline functions and includes other headers related to the fsmonitor feature in a version control system, most likely Git. It manages the state and validity of filesystem monitoring data in the index.

methods.name: int is_fsmonitor_refreshed(const struct index_state * istate)
methods.description: Checks whether the fsmonitor has been refreshed at least once by examining the mode and a flag in the index state.

methods.name: void mark_fsmonitor_valid(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Marks a cache entry as valid for fsmonitor, unless it is a submodule or fsmonitor is disabled.

methods.name: void mark_fsmonitor_invalid(struct index_state * istate,struct cache_entry * ce)
methods.description: Invalidates the fsmonitor validity mark on a cache entry and clears related untracked cache structures.

ctags.name: mark_fsmonitor_invalid
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mark_fsmonitor_invalid(struct index_state *istate, struct cache_entry *ce)$/

ctags.name: mark_fsmonitor_valid
ctags.pattern: /^static inline void mark_fsmonitor_valid(struct index_state *istate, struct cache_entry *ce)$/
